text: Naive direct realism easily accommodates illusions and perceptual variability, which is why it is the mainstream contemporary position.
explanation: False: naive direct realism notoriously struggles with illusions and perceptual variability (the stick that looks bent, colours under different lighting), which is why theorists move to critical/sophisticated direct realism or to disjunctivism. Its inability to handle non-veridical cases is its central weakness, not a strength.
